facts.value: State-sponsored Internet propaganda is Internet manipulation and propaganda that is sponsored by a state.

States have used the Internet, particularly social media, to influence elections, sow distrust in institutions, spread rumors, spread disinformation, typically using bots to create and spread content.
Propaganda is used internally to control populations.
Propaganda is used externally to influence other societies.
Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI) is used, particularly by the European Union, for state-sponsored Internet propaganda.
